resources.string: Your phone and laptop, on the same Wi-Fi.
Screen up. Point the top toward your laptop.
Left edge up: workspaces. Right edge up: scroll.
30 Hz sensor sampling instead of 60 Hz.
Open Levitate on your laptop. Join the same Wi-Fi, or connect your laptop to your phone’s hotspot. Scan the laptop QR. No account or internet needed.
Hold your phone with the screen facing up and its top toward the laptop. Tap Recenter. Rotate left/right to aim across the screen, and lift/lower the top to aim vertically.
Roll the phone until its left edge is higher. Sweep left or right to switch one workspace. Return screen-up to point again. Match shortcuts in the Linux preferences.
Roll the phone the other way. Tilt the top up/down to scroll vertically, or aim left/right for horizontal scrolling. You can also choose Scroll manually.
Tap the mouse buttons to click, or hold Left click and move to drag. Pause before putting the phone down. Touchpad mode lets a finger move the pointer; tap to click and drag two fingers to scroll.
Encrypted connection, no telemetry, no cloud. Sensors stop when you pause or leave the app. A QR code grants control of your laptop: generate a new one to revoke old pairing links.
